name: How do I price my home accurately when selling FSBO?

mainEntity.name: How do I price my home accurately when selling FSBO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurately pricing your home FSBO involves researching comparable sales (comps) in your area, considering market trends, and assessing your property's unique features and condition. You can access public records, review online real estate platforms, or even consider a professional appraisal. A practical tradeoff is balancing a price that attracts buyers quickly with maximizing your profit; an overpriced home often sits on the market longer, requiring eventual price reductions and increasing carrying costs, especially in dynamic markets like Miami.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price your FSBO home by researching comparable sales, market trends, and property features, balancing profit maximization with attracting buyers quickly.
